reasoning_content:
Make and python3 are already installed. Next, install kubectl, helm, and k3d. Get the latest versions:
- kubectl: https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt
- helm: https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.x.x-linux-amd64.tar.gz
- k3d: GitHub release

Install these to /usr/local/bin.

action.command: cd /tmp && KC=$(curl -sS -m 20 https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt) && echo "kubectl=$KC" && curl -sS -L -o kubectl "https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KC}/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl" && chmod +x kubectl && mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/ && kubectl version --client 2>/dev/null | head -1

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && KC=$(curl -sS -m 20 https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt) && echo \"kubectl=$KC\" && curl -sS -L -o kubectl \"https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KC}/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl\" && chmod +x kubectl && mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/ && kubectl version --client 2>/dev/null | head -1", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Install kubectl"}
